input: Directional revamp: build industries/nonprofits/ page (small nonprofits' problems -> Grant Autopilot, free nonprofit tools as front doors)
task: Nonprofits industry page (industries/nonprofits/): small nonprofits' common grant problems -> Grant Autopilot (live), seven free nonprofit tools as front doors
errors: candid.org is unreachable through the session proxy (DNS), so the Candid 22%/72% figure was checked against search-result quotes of the article, not the page itself.

First full check.mjs run found 12 problems: industries/ unknown to check.mjs, description 177 chars, and /grants/ links counted dead (Worker-served, not in the artifact). Fixed: INDUSTRIES_DIR in SITE_OWN_DIRS with a per-page disclaimer check, WORKER_SERVED_PREFIXES ['grants/'], description 142 chars.

doc_friction.issue: No notion of paths the Worker serves from another binding (/grants/), so the first page to link Grant Autopilot from the static site failed the dead-link check.

deviations.why: business.mjs (sibling's foundation) is not on main yet.
deviations.did: Page carries its own GRANT_AUTOPILOT data with a noted follow-up to move it into business.mjs and link from the industries index.
deviations.result: Page builds standalone; the conflict surface in build.mjs is kept to three small hunks.

notes: Grant Autopilot copy and prices read live from https://marisstella.app/grants and /grants/pricing on 2026-11-24. node --test industry-nonprofits.test.mjs check.test.mjs: pass.
